packageRules.description: group the garage-operator chart, its own image, and its vendored bootstrap CRDs into one PR -- all three track the same upstream rajsinghtech/garage-operator release and form the control plane, kept separate from the Garage data-plane image below since a control-plane bump carries different risk and doesn't need the data-plane falsification harness re-run

keep the Garage data-plane image in its own PR, separate from garage-operator above -- it's an independently versioned upstream project and the one that needs the falsification harness re-run on a bump, so it must never ride along with a routine operator patch
